english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese word for lightning, including both the visible flash and the electrical discharge.
Use this for the visible flash or spark produced during a lightning storm.

examples.english: There will be thunder and lightning tonight, so remember to close the windows properly.
examples.traditional: 今晚行雷閃電，記住閂好啲窗。
examples.jyutping: gam1 maan5 haang4 leoi4 sim2 din6 gei3 zyu6 saan1 hou2 di1 coeng1

examples.english: That bolt of lightning just now was so bright that it lit up the whole room.
examples.traditional: 頭先嗰下閃電好光，成間屋都照晒。
examples.jyutping: tau4 sin1 go2 haa5 sim2 din6 hou2 gwong1 seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 ziu3 saai3
